title: China's Top Nature Parks in 2026: Tickets, Booking & When to Go
description:
China's best national parks don't let you just show up. This is the 2026 playbook for tickets, real-name passport booking, daily caps and — just as important — timing, so you spend your trip inside the view instead of arguing at a gate.

Chapters:
0:00 Why you can't just show up
0:35 The one rule: real-name (passport) booking
1:45 Jiuzhaigou — book ahead, cap ~40,000/day, ~¥280, peak Oct 18–31
3:40 Zhangjiajie — 4-day pass ~¥228, Bailong Elevator (~¥72)
5:30 Timing the rest: clear-view & seasonal-access parks
7:10 The 5-point booking checklist
8:05 Which park is first on your list?

🧭 Expert Tip: Book the strict parks (Jiuzhaigou first) 1–2 weeks out on Trip.com for foreign passports, match the name to your passport exactly, and bring the original ID to every gate.
